title: 第9章 这场戏，有几分真假？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“谁！！！”

屠夫比利的反应非常快，枪口在第一时间就死死对准异响传出的桥头位置。

要不是他的身后还有贝卡，敌情又未明，他绝对会主动出击解决麻烦。

树后，莱恩稍微调整了一下表情。

被亲生儿子现场抓包应该是一种怎样的体验？

母亲贝卡的心情如何，尴尬与否？

这些问题他统统不去考虑，只想着8岁幼童撞见这样一幕画面应该是一个什么样的反应才合适。

并且他还要让母亲贝卡知道一些事，最好还能激怒比利。

所以他的语言应该是这样的。

“哦天呐，是，是莱恩……”

贝卡惊慌失措。

从树后走出来的居然是她的儿子莱恩，这是她无论如何都没有想到的事情。

她在异响传出来的瞬间甚至都做好了最坏的打算，直面祖国人！

“莱恩，你，你听妈妈解释。”

莱恩的表情看似非常的困惑，他先是用诧异且茫然的眼神看一眼屠夫比利，接着就对准母亲贝卡。

“妈妈，他是谁？”

“你，你为什么要这样做，爸爸会伤心的。”

知道男女之事可以从网络上解释，而最后一句‘爸爸会伤心的’指的是谁，在场的人全都心中有数。

绝对不是比利·布切尔。

屠夫瞬间破防。

贝卡的惊慌也变成了悲伤。

然后她拉住比利，痛苦地对儿子说道：“莱恩，事情并不是你认为的那样，祖国人他，他……”

到底还是太过难堪，贝卡哽咽得无法继续说下去。

莱恩惊诧：“祖国人他不是我爸？”

“他是。”

“那，爸爸和妈妈不应该是一起的吗？我看电影中都是那样演的啊？”

“听着，小子！”

这时，比利站了出来。

他安慰似的拍了拍哭泣的妻子肩膀，随后道：“莱恩，我和你的母亲才是真正的合法夫妻，而你的父亲祖国人，他只不过是一个邪恶、卑鄙、伪善且一无是处的恶棍。”

“不，说他是恶棍都是在夸奖他，他是个该下地狱的狗屎。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Who!!!"

Billy the Butcher reacted very quickly, and immediately aimed his gun at the bridge where the abnormal noise came from.

If it weren't for Beka behind him and the enemy's situation was unknown, he would definitely take the initiative to solve the problem.

Behind the tree, Ryan adjusted his expression slightly.

What should it be like to be caught live by your own son?

How is mother Becca feeling, embarrassed or not?

He didn't think about any of these issues. He only thought about what an appropriate reaction would be for an 8-year-old child to see such a scene.

And he also wants to let his mother Becca know something, preferably to anger Billy.

So his language should be like this.

"Oh my god, yes, it's Ryan..."

Beca panicked.

It was her son Ryan who walked out from behind the tree. This was something she never expected.

The moment the strange noise came out, she even prepared for the worst and faced the people of her motherland!

"Lian, you, listen to mom's explanation."

Ryan's expression seemed very confused. He first looked at Billy the Butcher with a surprised and blank look, and then he looked at his mother Becca.

"Mom, who is he?"

"You, why are you doing this? Dad will be sad."

I know that the relationship between men and women can be explained on the Internet, and everyone present knows who the last sentence "Dad will be sad" refers to.

Definitely not Billy Butcher.

The Butcher broke through the defense instantly.

Beca's panic turned to sadness.

Then she grabbed Billy and said to her son painfully: "Ryan, things are not what you think. He, a native of the motherland, he..."

After all, it was still too embarrassing, and Beca choked up and couldn't continue talking.

Ryan was surprised: "He's from the motherland and he's not my father?"

"He is."

"Then, shouldn't father and mother be together? Isn't it always like that in the movies I've seen?"

"Listen, kid!"

At this time, Billy stood up.

He patted his crying wife's shoulder comfortingly, and then said: "Ryan, your mother and I are the real legal couple, and your father, a native of the motherland, is just an evil, despicable, hypocritical and good-for-nothing villain."

"No, calling him a villain is a compliment. He's a piece of shit who deserves to go to hell."
